[/b][/size][/font][quote][font=Comic Sans MS]﻿[b][size=4]地图介绍 · Map Introduction[/size][/b]
[/font][/quote][font=Comic Sans MS]
[/font][center][font=Comic Sans MS][b]地图入口[/b]：秘密森林雕像旁
[b]Map entrance[/b]: Next to the statue of the Secret Forest

[/font][/center][font=Comic Sans MS][center]山谷外围，一条不知道源头的巧克力溪流落下，水里有各种各样奇妙的小鱼，你或许可以从小姜饼人们的口中获得一个关于溪流更深处的湖泊的线索？
听说外围闲逛还会不小心落入一个隐蔽的山洞，里面是甜蜜的危险，宝藏，还是什么隐藏于巧克力中的秘密奖品？
另外姜饼人居住在山谷的深处，找到他们的线索的那颗显眼的粉色大树！他们可是这里的原住民哦，也别忘了隐蔽在棉花糖灌木里的那只小老鼠，它可是重要的供货商哦！[/center][center]
On the outskirts of the valley, a chocolate stream with an unknown source tumbles down, teeming with all kinds of magical little fish. Perhaps you could gather a clue about the deeper lake of the stream from the small gingerbread people?
It's said that wandering around the outskirts might accidentally lead you into a hidden cave, where lies sweet danger, treasures, or perhaps some secret prizes hidden within chocolate?
Additionally, the gingerbread man lives deep in the valley, hidden behind that conspicuous pink tree where the clues lead! They are the original inhabitants of this place. And don’t forget the little mouse hiding in the marshmallow bushes—it’s an important supplier![/center]
